decisions.reason: As a flagship product line close to the core software business, it likely meets strategic aspirations well enough and the firm's growth and slack support continued commitment despite uncertainty.
The education institute extends customer relationships and complements the installed software base, so management would likely retain it unless results clearly fell below aspiration.
A remote support tool fits the firm's service-oriented offering and probably strengthens support efficiency, making it worth keeping under a growing firm's slack resources.
Practice analytics matches the firm's direction toward more digital and efficient practice management, so even if early results are mixed it remains close enough to core priorities to continue.
A complete practice bundle is tightly aligned with the established business and likely helps sales and customer retention, which makes discontinuation relatively unlikely.

The job and practice listing portal is the most distant from the firm's core capabilities and customer workflow software, so if performance is below aspiration management would likely redeploy resources elsewhere.
